implementation: Original bounded screenshot clients using the Python standard library

x11.transport: X11 socket protocol with scoped Xauthority MIT-MAGIC-COOKIE-1, TrueColor root GetImage and format/mask validation
x11.validation: New private authenticated Xvfb display, two screens (24/16-bit), bbox, original and AST-minified standalone worker, original sandbox_host flow through a local exec-transport fixture. Existing user displays and credentials are never used by tests.

windows.transport: ctypes OS user32/gdi32 APIs, scoped thread DPI awareness, BitBlt/PrintWindow and top-down 32-bit GetDIBits with handle cleanup
windows.validation: Portable fixed-width ABI/layout and byte conversion fixtures. A native Windows host capture has not been tested.

macos.transport: ctypes OS CoreGraphics/CoreFoundation APIs, selected display/window bounds, permission preflight, CGImage data provider and validated alpha/byte order conversion
macos.validation: Portable 64-bit CGRect ABI/layout and byte conversion fixtures. Native macOS capture, Retina coordinate behavior and availability of deprecated CoreGraphics capture APIs have not been tested.

unsupported: Wayland compositor/portal capture when no X11 server exposes the requested desktop
X11 non-TrueColor visual classes and optional authentication schemes other than MIT-MAGIC-COOKIE-1
macOS HDR/float and non-RGB screenshot formats
